units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 15:11">Targ. O. Deut. XV, 11</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:3:3">Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ</cite> top <he>אינש מ׳</he> a poor man. Y. Peah VII, 21ᵇ top; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִסְכֵּנִין</he>, <he>מִסְכֵּנַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="M01950"><he>מִסְכֵּי׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01393"><he>מִי׳</he></cite>. Targ. Y. Deut. l. c. (not <he>מַסְכְּנִין</he>).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 22:7">Targ. Prov. XXII, 7</cite>; a. e.—Y. Peah l. c. <he>יהב … דפלג למ׳</he> gave his son Samuel money to distribute among the poor. Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:6:5">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᶜ</cite> <he>ייתון מ׳ וכ׳</he> let the poor come and eat it, that it may not go to ruin.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:4:12">Y. Sot. III, 19ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:7:2">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>יליף זכי … מעשר מ׳</he> used to give him the tithes of the poor every third year; a. fr.—Denom.:
